name: codex-wechat-bridge
description: Bridge Codex tasks to WeChat with durable reply codes, exact quoted continuation, bounded notification refresh, desktop-visible tasks, branches, and attachments.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex tasks with WeChat ClawBot.
interface.longDescription: A Windows-native bridge connecting Codex lifecycle notifications to WeChat ClawBot without OpenClaw. Continue tasks with durable reply codes or verified quotes, retaining identity across renames. Supports new tasks, conversation branches, attachments, bounded refresh, backlog reset and replay guards. Existing-task submission still requires an unlocked, operable Codex desktop.
defaultPrompt: Check the Codex WeChat Bridge status.
Send a WeChat bridge test notification.
Enable the controlled WeChat to Codex relay.
